facts.question: Does the file state that household contents at the insured location (the Versicherungsort of the policy) were stolen or damaged by a burglary, a robbery or a simple theft (including vandalism), even if nothing was taken?
Does the file state that the theft or damage was caused by a person who lived in the same household as the policyholder at the time?

Was the theft a burglary (the thief forcibly entered the building or a room of it, or broke open a container in it, or unlocked it with the correct keys or codes that the thief had obtained by burglary or robbery; a vehicle is not a container) or a robbery (theft under threat or use of violence against the policyholder or a member of the household, or while they could not resist because of unconsciousness, accident or death; pickpocketing and trick theft are not robbery), and so not a simple theft?
Does the claim include costs, caused by the theft, of changing or replacing keys, magnetic cards or locks at the location named in the policy, or at a bank safe the policyholder rents?

Does the file state that traces of the theft (for example pry marks, a broken lock, window or container) have been removed or altered, or are to be removed or altered, by the policyholder or on their behalf, for example by repair or cleaning?
Is a bicycle among the stolen or damaged items?
Does the file state that the original purchase vouchers for all of the stolen or damaged items cannot be obtained, or only at considerable cost (not even as a duplicate from the seller)?
Does the file state that measures to reduce the loss are still to be taken (not yet carried out)?
Does the file state that the measures could not wait for the insurer's instruction because of imminent danger (Gefahr im Verzug)?

facts.question: Does the file state that household contents were stolen or damaged by a theft outside the insured location that was neither a burglary (the thief forcibly entered the building or a room of it, or broke open a container in it, or unlocked it with the correct keys or codes that the thief had obtained by burglary or robbery; a vehicle is not a container) or a robbery (theft under threat or use of violence against the policyholder or a member of the household, or while they could not resist because of unconsciousness, accident or death; pickpocketing and trick theft are not robbery)?
Does the policy, or the file, show that the policy does not include the separate supplementary insurance for simple theft away from home (einfacher Diebstahl auswärts)?

Does the file state that traces of the theft (for example pry marks, a broken lock, window or container) have been removed or altered, or are to be removed or altered, by the policyholder or on their behalf, for example by repair or cleaning?
Is a bicycle among the stolen or damaged items?
Does the file state that the original purchase vouchers for all of the stolen or damaged items cannot be obtained, or only at considerable cost (not even as a duplicate from the seller)?
